# What the vendored TMF specs define and the app does not take or give.
# Generated by the probe in tests/tmf_gaps.py, locked by tests/test_tmf_gaps.py: closing a
# gap means removing its line. Kinds: refused (unknown attribute, 400), read-only (400),
# requires (we require, the spec does not), missing (never returned; "a.b": one level into
# a returned value), content-type (415), base path. Behaviour gaps (states, rewrites,
# order) are in docs/tmf-gap-analysis.md.
# Restrictions for the new contracts (TMF639 implemented, TMF654 reads and hub implemented):
# TMF639: LogicalResource/msisdn only; other subclasses and non-number states are
# excluded from number inventory. Assigned numbers use busy; quarantine uses the
# free-string allocationStatus, never a new usageState enum.
# TMF654: monetary only; no usage rating, recurring adjustment, automatic top-up,
# vouchers or future operator holds. Monetary Quantity requires explicit amount
# and units; reserveBalance requires an explicit amount (no inferred all-funds hold).
# Executed action financial/ownership fields are immutable; transfers are final.
# BalanceActionHistory: waive required receiverLogicalResource only for persisted
# TopupBalance, AdjustBalance and ReserveBalance kinds. Status always remains required;
# transfers validate against the unchanged schema. No fictitious receiver is added.
# Events: register all declared names; TransferBalanceCancelEvent is unreachable.
# Listener paths are subscriber endpoints, not BSS operations or missing endpoints.
# TMF654 balanceActionHistory: 2 absent endpoints (tests/tmf_gaps.py PENDING).
# Buckets, accumulated balances and the hub use the attribute probes.
TMF654 GET /balanceActionHistory endpoint absent
TMF654 GET /balanceActionHistory/{id} endpoint absent

# accepted deviations: gaps kept on purpose, each with its reason (docs/decisions/tmf-api.md,
# "The last gaps"). The probe still finds them; the lock is exact.
# POST /product: billing cannot charge a product without an account and an offering.
TMF637 POST /product requires billingAccount
TMF637 POST /product requires productOffering
# TMF639 number-only inventory: no network/alarm/lifecycle management. The built-in
# specification has no resource catalog URL, name or version. Name/value are required;
# href and PATCH id are managed by the server. See docs/decisions/prepaid.md (N3).
TMF639 GET /resource/{id} missing alarmStatus
TMF639 GET /resource/{id} missing availabilityStatus
TMF639 GET /resource/{id} missing controlStatus
TMF639 GET /resource/{id} missing lifecycleState
TMF639 GET /resource/{id} missing operationalState
TMF639 GET /resource/{id} missing proceduralStatus
TMF639 GET /resource/{id} missing resourceSpecification.href
TMF639 GET /resource/{id} missing resourceSpecification.name
TMF639 GET /resource/{id} missing resourceSpecification.version
TMF639 GET /resource/{id} missing unknownStatus
TMF639 PATCH /resource/{id} read-only href
TMF639 PATCH /resource/{id} read-only id
TMF639 PATCH /resource/{id} refused alarmStatus
TMF639 PATCH /resource/{id} refused availabilityStatus
TMF639 PATCH /resource/{id} refused controlStatus
TMF639 PATCH /resource/{id} refused lifecycleState
TMF639 PATCH /resource/{id} refused operationalState
TMF639 PATCH /resource/{id} refused proceduralStatus
TMF639 PATCH /resource/{id} refused unknownStatus
TMF639 POST /resource read-only href
TMF639 POST /resource refused alarmStatus
TMF639 POST /resource refused availabilityStatus
TMF639 POST /resource refused controlStatus
TMF639 POST /resource refused lifecycleState
TMF639 POST /resource refused operationalState
TMF639 POST /resource refused proceduralStatus
TMF639 POST /resource refused unknownStatus
TMF639 POST /resource requires name
TMF639 POST /resource requires value
# TMF654 bucket: a view of the account's funding ledger, never a deduction, so it has no
# requestedDate/confirmationDate (balance actions carry theirs). Monetary credit does not
# expire: validFor starts at the bucket's creation and has no end; a closed account's
# bucket stays readable as expired. See docs/decisions/prepaid.md (P4c).
# TMF654 adjustBalance: relatedParty is not in the Create schema and the owner is already on
# the bucket and the partyAccount; recurring adjustments are a 422 (never returned). P4e.
TMF654 GET /adjustBalance/{id} missing relatedParty
TMF654 GET /bucket/{id} missing confirmationDate
TMF654 GET /bucket/{id} missing requestedDate
TMF654 GET /bucket/{id} missing validFor.endDateTime
# TMF654 reserveBalance: the Create schema leaves amount optional, but a hold without an amount
# holds nothing, so it is required (422); relatedParty is as for adjustBalance. P4f.
TMF654 GET /reserveBalance/{id} missing relatedParty
# TMF654 topupBalance: automatic top-ups and vouchers need payment collection and voucher
# management this BSS does not have (422, never returned); relatedParty is not in the Create
# schema and the owner is already on the bucket and the partyAccount. P4d.
TMF654 GET /topupBalance/{id} missing numberOfPeriods
TMF654 GET /topupBalance/{id} missing recurringPeriod
TMF654 GET /topupBalance/{id} missing relatedParty
TMF654 GET /topupBalance/{id} missing voucher
# TMF654 transferBalance: relatedParty is not in the Create schema and the sender is already on
# the bucket and the partyAccount; the receiver is on receiverBucket. P4g.
TMF654 GET /transferBalance/{id} missing relatedParty
TMF654 POST /reserveBalance requires amount
# accountBalance: one current balance per currency - the balance now, with no period.
TMF666 GET /billingAccount/{id} missing accountBalance.validFor
# billDocument: the document is embedded (content); it has no address of its own (href,
# url) and no validity period.
TMF678 GET /customerBill/{id} missing billDocument.href
TMF678 GET /customerBill/{id} missing billDocument.url
TMF678 GET /customerBill/{id} missing billDocument.validFor
